description: Figure 5 is a bar chart that illustrates the proportion of incorrectly answered samples where RPop_Ge is less than RPop_GT. The chart has three sets of bars, each representing a different category: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The bars are color-coded with blue, red, and yellow, respectively. The y-axis is labeled "Popularity" and ranges from 0 to 220, with intervals of 20. The x-axis lists the three categories. The blue bars (Movies) show the highest values, followed by the red bars (Songs), and the yellow bars (Basketball) show the lowest values. The chart is used to compare the proportion of incorrectly answered samples across the three categories.
